name: Wand of Orcus

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

powers.name: Call Undead
powers.text: Once per dawn: undead rise to serve you for an hour.

summary: Orcus's skull-topped rod: a +3 mace dealing 2d12 Necrotic more, +3 AC, and necromancy (save DC 18).
text: The ghastly Wand of Orcus rarely leaves the side of Orcus, the Demon Prince of Undeath. This rod functions as a magic Mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it, and it deals an extra 2d12 Necrotic damage on a hit. While attuned, you gain a +3 bonus to Armor Class. The wand has 7 charges and regains 1d4 + 3 expended charges daily at dawn; you can expend them to cast Animate Dead (1), Blight (2), Circle of Death (3), Finger of Death (3), Power Word Kill (4) or Speak with Dead (1), save DC 18. Once per dawn you can call undead to serve you for an hour. Any non-undead creature that isn't attuned and touches it takes 10d6 Necrotic damage. The wand is sentient and wants to return to Orcus.
